description: Validate a tool-call args object against a small shape spec. Returns { valid, error?, retry_hint? } where retry_hint is a ready-to-send LLM feedback message describing exactly what was wrong.

args.description: The args object the LLM wants to pass.

shape.description: Shape spec mapping field name to type. Types: "string", "number", "boolean", "array", "object". Suffix with "?" for optional. Example: { "name": "string", "age": "number", "tags": "array", "notes": "string?" }

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being called (surfaces in retry_hint).

name: validate_tool_args
